The topology is intact: diff-pair polarity, mirror connections, pass device, and feedback divider (R1 = R2 gives 2× → 1.2 V) all check out. The failing metric is post-step ringing (0.70 V settled vs. a 10 mV limit), which points to poor loop damping rather than a wiring error. The compensation capacitor is the most likely corrupted value. At 35 fF it is far too small for a Miller cap stabilizing a 1 nF load. The pass device and tail mirror are the next most plausible sources of reduced phase margin.
